Bind September 16 decision and September 17 effective date explicitly. Have deterministic code extract the announced annual percentage rates for reserve balances (3.90 percent), standing overnight repo (4.0 percent), and standing overnight reverse repo (3.75 percent); render one labelled categorical comparison for this single effective date with source URL, units, announcement/effective dates and announced-policy-setting status. No fabricated history, interpolation, forecast or observed-market-rate label; any differences must be computed by code. Explain reserve remuneration, liquidity provision and cash absorption only to the extent supported by admitted source text; distinguish mechanism interpretation from documented settings and flag additional official operational documentation if needed. The serious countercase is that administered settings do not alone prove effective pass-through to bank deposits, credit or asset prices; no observed pass-through or causal market reaction is supplied. Next observation requires exact subsequent official policy/operation evidence with its own date and lineage, not assumed implementation outcomes. Preserve accepted public Main manifest context without promoting it to independent official-source evidence. Use policy/release-photo-asset.json for the separately cleared authentic Kevin Warsh May 22 archive photo; retain its caption, attribution, date and context-only classification, and use the recorded September minutes role binding without claiming this worker independently verified the minutes or inspected pixels. Photo is not September-event documentation or policy corroboration. Carry all factual, rights and identity bindings to the writer; unresolved bindings remain explicit, not invented.
